reference: Approved soft 2D robot, dust bunny and parquet style board

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production Unity 2D top-down game sprite on truly transparent background. Use attached image ONLY as style and robot identity reference. Draw only the cream-white round robot vacuum from the reference, not the board, floor, other characters or inset. Smooth dark plum outlines, soft matte shading, cream body, small cyan lidar sensor toward upper half, dark front intake at bottom, two small side brushes. Camera overhead with very minimal visible front edge, same direction as reference, front faces down. Keep compact circular silhouette centered at canvas center with balanced transparent padding about 8 percent on each side; no detached particles. Sensor can glow subtle cyan but NO fixed battery-status light or pink status LED because the game overlays a dynamic one. Whole sprite fully visible, no clipping. Crisp curved edges readable at 60 screen pixels, low detail, no pixel art, no glossy 3D, no text, no frame, no ground, no checkerboard drawn in the image. Actual alpha transparency required.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production Unity 2D enemy sprite on truly transparent background. Use attached image ONLY as style and dust-bunny identity reference. Draw only the cute gray-lilac fluffy dust creature from the reference, with mischievous small dark eyes and tiny cheerful mouth, a few soft curled dust fibers, rounded compact silhouette. No rabbit ears, no arms, no feet, no extra creatures. Soft cartoon 2D hand-drawn smooth dark plum outlines, gentle restrained shading, gray lavender fluffy body, same palette and style as reference. Near-overhead top-down game view matching the reference. Center shape at canvas center, full creature visible with balanced transparent padding about 8 percent each side. No detached floating dust or particles outside body, no cast floor shadow, no environment, no border, no labels, no text, no drawn checkerboard. Actual alpha transparency required. Must read as dust at 35 screen pixels, not a plush rabbit or furry animal.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE square seamless repeatable 2D Unity floor texture, full bleed opaque image. Use attached image ONLY as art style and floor material reference. Draw a strictly orthographic directly overhead warm dark brown parquet wood floor, hand-painted soft cartoon 2D with smooth understated grain and narrow dark seams. Simplify into a REGULAR straight horizontal staggered wood plank brick-bond pattern: exactly four equally tall rows, each row divided into planks half the image width, alternate rows offset by a quarter image width. This rectangular pattern must tile seamlessly across LEFT/RIGHT and TOP/BOTTOM image boundaries; repeat the same palette, grain density and seam width right up to all edges. No perspective, no bevel around overall image, no rounded corners, no border, no drop shadow, no lighting gradient, no vignette, no spotlight, no furniture, no robot, no dust, no characters, no icons, no text. Muted low-contrast warm dark walnut tones suitable as a nighttime gameplay background behind a cream robot and gray lilac dust enemies. The texture is the entire square image, not a swatch placed on a background. Uniform overall illumination, avoid conspicuous knots or unique marks that reveal repetition.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: seamless repeating top-down 2D game floor texture. Edit the attached floor texture ONLY. Preserve its warm dark walnut color, soft hand-painted cartoon 2D style, opaque square full-bleed format, four equal horizontal plank rows, staggered vertical joints, narrow dark plank seams. FIX ONLY tiling artifacts: make every plank's base brightness consistent, remove all broad dark/light rectangular patches, remove any vignette or overall lighting gradient and any edge darkening. Use extremely subtle uniform woodgrain. Each row's LEFT edge must match its RIGHT edge in color and woodgrain so adjacent copies have NO visible vertical stripe at the tile border; match TOP and BOTTOM borders as a single continuous horizontal plank seam, with no double thick seam. The seamless periodic unit is exactly four rows and two plank widths per row, alternate rows offset one quarter canvas width. Uniform low contrast wood color everywhere apart from thin seam lines and understated grain, no wide color bands. Strict overhead orthographic, no perspective, no objects, no text, no frame, no rounded overall corners, no shadows or lighting. This will tile across a 60x60 Unity arena, and visible large checkerboard blocks are unacceptable. Keep overall average hue dark warm brown; do not brighten the floor.
